messages:
sam: hey team, urgent — just got a positive test and need to drop primary for my window. Pager is firing for EU embeddings (p95 spike). I can do a soft handoff but need someone to take full primary right now. @maria @alex can you confirm?

incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED: EU embeddings latency (INC-2026-042) — p95 ~1.9s, error rate +2.3%. Pager sent to #eng-oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-embed-latency

maria: I can take primary — switching to primary in 2 mins. will follow the runbook and coordinate mitigation. @jen heads-up if we need capacity commits. :wave:

alex: I can be secondary for the window. monitoring dashboards open.

sam: thanks both. leaving my laptop alive for 10m to help if needed, then will be offline. quick note: some customers on the EA tier reported 504s. might be tied to KV cache thrash.

maria: ok taking primary. first actions: 1) isolate problem nodes, 2) scale EU pool by +2 reps, 3) reroute 20% traffic to NA for non-SLA customers. Doing step 1 now.

maria: isolating node id: eu-gpu-17 (evicting live connections). command I ran:

```
# drain node
./infra-tool drain --node eu-gpu-17 --reason "OOM suspected" --timeout 120
```

ops-bot: drain job submitted: job-9876. Expected drain complete ~90s.

alex: adding a note: if drain doesn't reduce KV cache misses we should switch to full prefix caching fallback. runbook section 3.2 has the commands.

maria: drain succeeded. next I bumped capacity:

```
# scale eu pool
./infra-tool scale --pool eu-embed --replicas +2 --reason "mitigation"
```

ops-bot: scale request accepted, new target replicas +2. provisioning in progress.

maria: starting controlled routing change to shift non-SLA (free-tier) to NA. command:

```
# traffic split (20% free-tier -> na-region)
./router update-split --route /v1/embeddings --tag free-tier --weight na:20,eu:80 --reason "latency mitigation"
```

on-critical note: this is temporary and documented in runbook section 4.1.

jen: please confirm customers affected list and ping CS with the short blurb. I can approve capacity billing if we need reserved burst.

maria: will send CS blurb in a sec. Draft: "We’re experiencing elevated embedding latency for EU customers; we’re temporarily shifting a fraction of traffic for non-SLA customers to NA to restore responsiveness while we remediate. Paid customers and critical routes unaffected"

alex: dashboards show p95 dropping to 0.55s for the routed traffic, overall p95 now ~0.9s. error rate decreasing. good sign.

maria: marking incident step: mitigation applied. updating runbook notes and the incident doc.

oncall-rotation-bot: @maria is now set as primary for shift (handoff from sam). @alex set as secondary. Handoff note: sam stepped down due to illness.

sam: thanks, appreciate the quick takeover. one more: reminder to run the KV cache compaction after things stabilize — runbook cmd at the end of thread.

maria: noted. after stabilization I'll run compaction:

```
# compact KV cache
./cache-tool compact --pool eu-embed --max-ttl 2h --dry-run=false
```

maria: cs notified with blurb and ticket number: CS-1123. jen — if you approve scaling costs we'll keep +2 until morning or until p95 < 0.5s for 30m.

jen: approved for now. keep me posted.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (routing + scale). p95 trending down. Cases: 12 customer tickets opened (CS-1123).

maria: will keep monitoring and post a postmortem draft once stable. alex — please own follow-up ops tasks: run cache compaction, verify node health, and coordinate rollback of traffic split once stable. I’ll add them as checklist items.

alex: got it — will run compaction and verify. planning rollback if stable for 45m.

maria: new status 10m after mitigation: p95 0.48s for EU overall, error rate back to baseline. leaving primary in place and will request rollback in ~45m if stable.

oncall-rotation-bot: reminder: update the shared calendar if you extend primary beyond your listed window.

sam: thanks everyone. going offline now. good handoff. :white_check_mark:

maria: copying final checklist to incident doc and closing handoff thread. will update with postmortem link later."
